domains.name: Zendesk AI Foundations (AI agents, intelligent triage, intent/sentiment detection)
Bot Building and Conversation Design (flow builder, answer bot, escalation paths)
AI-Powered Triage and Routing (intelligent triage, skills-based routing, AI suggestions)
Reporting AI Performance (bot metrics, deflection rate, CSAT for AI interactions)

exam_rules: Online proctored exam via Kryterion Webassessor. Closed book. No notes, calculators, or external resources. Webcam monitoring throughout. Exam session is recorded.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID (passport, driving licence, national ID); webcam and microphone required for online proctoring via Kryterion

prerequisites.description: Recommended: Zendesk Support Administrator experience; familiarity with Zendesk AI features and bots

renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years; renewal requires re-examination at current exam fee ($299)

retake_policy.notes: One free retake included with each exam purchase after 7-day waiting period; subsequent retakes require full repurchase at $299
